data.name: Elfgineer
data.detailed_description:
About Elfgineer

The Grinch has struck the North Pole, poisoning every elf responsible for toy production…

Every elf, except one.

You are the last Elfgineer — a brilliant tinkerer determined to save Christmas. Forget handcrafting toys the old-fashioned way — it’s time to automate the magic.

Build conveyor belts, design machines, and create sprawling production lines powered by festive energy. Combine resources like wood, copper, wool, paint, and even falling stars to craft toys, wrap gifts, and fill Santa’s sleigh before the big night arrives.

Manage your factory, optimize your layouts, and unlock wondrous new technologies as you fight to bring joy back to the world — all in the name of restoring Christmas spirit.

Can one elf and a mountain of machines save Christmas?

Features:

🧰 Automate the North Pole

Build conveyor belts, machines, and toy assemblers to mass-produce festive creations.

🌲 Harvest Magical Resources

Gather wood, copper, wool, paint, and falling stars — the essential ingredients of Christmas.

🎁 Craft Toys and Gifts

Combine your resources to create trains, dolls, wrapping paper, boxes, and presents fit for Santa’s sleigh.

🧠 Design Ingenious Factories

Plan efficient layouts, balance production chains, and perfect your output for maximum holiday efficiency.

✨ Unlock Festive Technology

Research new machines, automation upgrades, and whimsical inventions powered by Christmas spirit.

🎅 Restore Holiday Cheer

Deliver toys, expand your workshop empire, and push back the Grinch’s influence one gift at a time.

🎨 Cozy Handcrafted World

Enjoy a warm, colorful art style filled with twinkling lights, snowflakes, and the hum of cheerful machinery.

🔔 Relax or Optimize

Play your way — unwind and build at your own pace, or chase perfect production ratios in Christmas Crunch Mode!

Join the Workshop!

Elfgineer is currently in active development — and you’re invited to help shape it!

Share your ideas, feedback, and festive spirit with us on Discord and YouTube as we build this magical factory together.

Let’s make sure no elf (or machine) gets left behind this Christmas.

data.short_description: Elfgineer is a cozy factory game where you design the most important factory in the world, Santa's workshop. Automate toy production, craft festive contraptions and unlock new recipes, machines and technologies. Build, optimize and maximize christmas spirit before time runs out on Christmas Eve!
